findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/review-run.ts:1586 [medium] collectReviewerEvidenceState unconditionally reads prompt-envelopes.json even when reviewerFindings and reviewerPasses are both empty. This violates CHK-002:edge:0 explicit zero-record no-unnecessary-envelope-read contract and adds ledger I/O to every empty readiness check; the pre-change collector did not read the envelope ledger on that path. Guard snapshot creation on the presence of evidence while retaining the shared snapshot for non-empty collections.

packages/main/src/tasks/review-incremental-context-smoke.ts:626-647 and .proof-or-stop/story/actives/B-a2a6/acceptance-rollout-report.json:1423-1427 — the mandatory Wave 4 coverage is not executable evidence for this story: the smoke only asserts one collector read plus one valid B pass, while the signed rollout inventory lists acceptance_topology_check, pre_review_check, and acceptance_rollout_check only. There is no executable receipt for pre_review_check_read or acceptance_rollout_report_read, degraded-3x1 rejection, mode-invariant diagnostics, enforce-only blocking, or non-destructive rollback history. Prompt prose and inventory metadata cannot satisfy this boundary.

packages/main/src/core/review-run.ts:1582-1602 — collectReviewerEvidenceState unconditionally reads prompt-envelopes.json at line 1586 before iterating reviewer evidence, so a collection with zero bound records still performs one ledger read, contradicting CHK-002:edge:0, which requires zero records to cause no unnecessary envelope read. packages/main/src/tasks/review-incremental-context-smoke.ts:626-647 exercises only the three-pass fixture and never covers the empty collection.

.proof-or-stop/story/actives/B-a2a6/red-evidence.json:8-19 — the only red record targets CHK-001:happy:0 but records B-dc83 as both failing and expected green command, and its note explicitly says green is only expected after the separate cache fix; it contains no observed green exit code, receipt, output digest, or current HEAD/material binding for B-a2a6. The checklist receipts at .proof-or-stop/story/actives/B-a2a6/checklist.json:115-120 and 404-422 are smoke-test receipts and are not linked to RED-20260824022500 or the failing story_advance command, so the required red-to-green regression is not proven.

packages/main/src/tasks/review-incremental-context-smoke.ts:626-647 and .proof-or-stop/story/actives/B-a2a6/checklist.json:357-399 — the cached-vs-uncached and adversarial verificationIntent is overclaimed: the fixture checks one three-pass collection read count and that passB is valid, but never captures an uncached aggregate baseline or compares accepted/rejected records, integrity, cutoff, findings/pass classification, and gate outcome. It also does not inject read failures or source changes, exercise empty/single/many records, duplicate/stale/scope-invalid records, or vary order/cutoff boundaries. Reusing the same CACHE SNAPSHOT selector for all five CHK-002 intents is not concrete coverage of those mutations.
